mapper.select: SELECT id, app_code, dimension_code, dimension_name, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM iam_data_dimension WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode} AND dimension_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dimensionCode}, '%') AND dimension_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dimensionName}, '%') ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, app_code, dimension_code, dimension_name, dimension_data_json, dimension_script, sort, remark, version FROM iam_data_dimension WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode} AND dimension_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dimensionCode}, '%') AND dimension_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dimensionName}, '%') ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, app_code, dimension_code, version FROM iam_data_dimension WHERE deleted = 0 AND dimension_code IN ( #{item} )
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_data_dimension SET app_code = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.appCode} END, dimension_name = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.dimensionName} END, dimension_data_json = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.dimensionDataJson} END, dimension_script = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.dimensionScript} END, remark = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.remark} END, sort = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.sort} END, update_by = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.updateBy} END, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN ( #{item.id} )
